title: Spatial Memory Intelligence: Endowing World Models with Understanding-Driven Long-Term Memory
title_zh: 空间记忆智能：赋予世界模型以理解驱动型长期记忆

paragraphs.en: Long-video generation and world models have shown strong potential for interactive entertainment and embodied simulation by predicting future observations conditioned on user actions and historical memory. However, as memory sequences grow longer and their structures become increasingly complex, managing long-range spatial context becomes increasingly challenging, calling for a more intelligent and systematic memory-management strategy. Building on the advancing spatial reasoning capabilities of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) and the broader vision of unified models, we propose Spatial Memory Intelligence (SMI), the first framework to systematically employ an understanding model for spatial-memory management in long-video world models. SMI introduces four coordinated atomic operations: spatial clustering, within-cluster sparsification, action-aware retrieval, and reliability-aware filtering. Extensive experiments across multiple baselines, benchmarks, and world-model backbones demonstrate the effectiveness and generalizability of SMI, achieving comprehensive improvements in memory sparsity, generation stability, and spatial consistency.

paragraphs.en: World models are driving a pivotal shift in visual and spatial intelligence, moving generative modeling toward controllable simulation of environments. Within this paradigm, video provides a natural medium for representing both the visual appearance and temporal evolution of an environment. Video world models ( Parker-Holder & Fruchter, 2025 ; Che et al., 2025 ; Sun et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026b ; Mao et al., 2026 ; Gao et al., 2026 ) serve as interactive visual simulators by conditioning future visual states on historical observations, language instructions, and camera signals. This interactivity enables spatial exploration across different regions of the generated world, where newly generated observations are continuously appended to the visual history and become part of the context for future prediction. Through this iterative process, the model progressively integrates observations from different regions and viewpoints into an evolving world state that captures semantics and geometry, making video world models a promising foundation for interactive entertainment ( Tang et al., 2025 ; Team et al., 2026a ) and embodied simulation ( Agarwal et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 世界模型正在推动视觉与空间智能领域的关键性转变，使生成式建模迈向对环境的可控模拟。 在这一范式下，视频为表现环境的视觉外观与时间演化提供了自然的媒介。 视频世界模型（Parker-Holder & Fruchter, 2025；Che et al., 2025；Sun et al., 2025；Wang et al., 2026b；Mao et al., 2026；Gao et al., 2026）通过将未来视觉状态与历史观测、语言指令和摄像头信号相结合，充当交互式视觉模拟器。 这种交互性使得在生成的世界不同区域中进行空间探索成为可能：新生成的观测结果会持续附加到视觉历史中，并成为未来预测的上下文组成部分。 通过这一迭代过程，模型逐步将来自不同区域和视角的观测整合进一个不断演化的世界状态中，该状态能够捕捉语义与几何信息，使视频世界模型成为交互式娱乐（Tang et al., 2025；Team et al., 2026a）和具身模拟（Agarwal et al., 2026；Chen et al., 2026）的有前景基础。

paragraphs.en: The continual evolution of the generated world poses intertwined challenges for memory efficiency, spatial consistency, and generation stability. As the observation history grows, retaining all observations introduces substantial redundancy and incurs high storage costs, motivating memory sparsification ( Yu et al., 2025c ; Zhang et al., 2025a ) . In parallel, maintaining spatial consistency requires retrieving memories of previously observed regions that provide relevant semantic and geometric evidence. Failure to retrieve such evidence can lead to geometric inconsistencies in revisited regions and unintended changes in object identities or states ( King et al., 2026 ; Wu et al., 2026 ; Hu et al., 2026 ) . Moreover, newly generated observations may themselves contain errors. If admitted into memory and reused as references, these errors can propagate and compound during autoregressive generation, undermining long-horizon stability ( Liu et al., 2026b ; Zhang et al., 2025a ) . Together, these challenges call for systematic spatial-memory management that determines what to retain, what to retrieve, and which new observations are reliable enough to store.
paragraphs.zh: 生成世界的持续演化对记忆效率、空间一致性和生成稳定性提出了相互交织的挑战。 随着观察历史的增长，保留所有观察结果会引入大量冗余并产生高昂的存储成本，因此有必要对记忆进行稀疏化（Yu et al., 2025c; Zhang et al., 2025a）。 与此同时，维持空间一致性需要检索先前观察区域的相关记忆，这些记忆能够提供相关的语义和几何证据。 若未能检索到此类证据，可能导致在重访区域出现几何不一致性，以及物体身份或状态的意外变化（King et al., 2026; Wu et al., 2026; Hu et al., 2026）。 此外，新生成的观察结果本身也可能包含错误。 如果这些错误被纳入记忆并作为参考重复使用，它们可能会在自回归生成过程中传播和累积，从而破坏长期稳定性（Liu et al., 2026b; Zhang et al., 2025a）。 综合来看，这些挑战要求一种系统化的空间-记忆管理机制，以决定哪些内容应被保留、哪些需要被检索，以及哪些新观察结果足够可靠可以存储。

paragraphs.en: Existing approaches to memory management in world models primarily focus on memory compression, sparse computation, and selective retrieval. Compression-based methods ( Jin et al., 2025 ; Savov et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2026 ; Hong et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ; Wei et al., 2026 ) summarize an expanding context into a bounded representation, often discarding fine-grained visual evidence needed to maintain long-horizon consistency. Sparse-computation methods ( Xi et al., 2025 ; Xia et al., 2025 ) exploit attention sparsity to reduce computational cost, but target generation efficiency rather than long-term memory management. To maintain spatial consistency, retrieval-based methods select relevant historical observations as context based on geometric relations or semantic similarity. Geometry-based retrieval ( Yu et al., 2025a ; Xiao et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2025c ; Ren et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025c ) relies on camera or geometry relevance and is sensitive to occlusion, dynamic content, semantic changes and geometry errors. Semantic retrieval ( Ji et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2025d ) captures high-level relevance but can struggle to distinguish similar content across different locations or viewpoints. Some methods jointly address memory compression and implicit content querying ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) through an auxiliary encoder and the generative model itself, but remain constrained by their limited spatial perception and semantic understanding. These limitations motivate a unified memory manager that organizes, sparsifies, and retrieves spatial context while reasoning over both geometry and semantics.
paragraphs.zh: 世界模型中现有的内存管理方法主要关注内存压缩、稀疏计算和选择性检索。 基于压缩的方法（Jin et al., 2025；Savov et al., 2025；Wu et al., 2026；Hong et al., 2025；Zhang et al., 2026b；Wei et al., 2026）将不断扩展的上下文总结为有界表示，通常会丢弃维持长期一致性所需的精细视觉证据。 稀疏计算方法（Xi et al., 2025；Xia et al., 2025）利用注意力的稀疏性来降低计算成本，但其目标是提升生成效率，而非长期内存管理。 为了维持空间一致性，基于检索的方法会根据几何关系或语义相似性选择相关的历史观察作为上下文。 基于几何的检索方法（Yu et al., 2025a；Xiao et al., 2025；Wu et al., 2025c；Ren et al., 2025；Li et al., 2025c）依赖相机或几何相关性，且对遮挡、动态内容、语义变化和几何错误较为敏感。 基于语义的检索方法（Ji et al., 2025；Wu et al., 2025d）能够捕捉高层相关性，但可能难以区分不同位置或视角下的相似内容。 一些方法通过辅助编码器和生成模型本身，联合处理内存压缩和隐式内容查询（Zhang et al., 2026b），但仍受限于其有限的空间感知和语义理解能力。 这些局限性促使我们设计一种统一的内存管理器，能够在推理几何与语义的同时，组织、稀疏化和检索空间上下文。

paragraphs.en: Recent MLLMs have made substantial progress in long-video understanding, spatial perception, and reasoning ( Bai et al., 2025b ; Chen et al., 2024b ; Yang et al., 2025a ; Yang et al., 2025b ) . Meanwhile, a growing line of work explores unified multimodal architectures that support both understanding and generation ( Wu et al., 2025a ; Xie et al., 2025 ; Deng et al., 2025 ) . Motivated by the spatial and semantic capabilities of understanding models and by the broader vision of unified understanding and generation , we propose Spatial Memory Intelligence (SMI), the first framework to systematically employ an understanding model for spatial-memory management in long-video world models. SMI decomposes spatial-memory management into four coordinated atomic operations (Figure 2 ): spatial clustering, within-cluster sparsification, action-aware retrieval, and reliability-aware filtering. Spatial clustering structures the memory by grouping spatially proximate memory chunks into the same cluster. Within-cluster sparsification removes redundant observations from each cluster to reduce storage costs. Action-aware retrieval combines the recent context with the current action to determine which historical memories provide the most useful spatial evidence for generating the next chunk. Reliability-aware filtering prevents newly generated chunks exhibiting visual drift from entering memory, limiting error propagation through subsequent reuse. Together, these atomic operations constitute a complete and unified mechanism for spatial-memory management.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在长视频理解、空间感知和推理方面取得了显著进展（Bai 等人，2025b；Chen 等人，2024b；Yang 等人，2025a；Yang 等人，2025b）。 与此同时，越来越多的研究开始探索统一的跨模态架构，以支持理解与生成双重功能（Wu 等人，2025a；Xie 等人，2025；Deng 等人，2025）。 受理解模型在空间与语义方面的能力，以及统一理解与生成这一更宏大愿景的启发，我们提出了空间记忆智能（Spatial Memory Intelligence, SMI）——首个系统性地利用理解模型来管理长视频世界模型中空间记忆的框架。 SMI 将空间记忆管理分解为四个协同的原子操作（图2）：空间聚类、簇内稀疏化、动作感知检索和可靠性感知过滤。 空间聚类通过将空间上邻近的记忆片段分组到同一簇中，从而组织记忆结构。 簇内稀疏化通过从每个簇中移除冗余的观察数据，来降低存储成本。 动作感知检索将近期上下文与当前动作相结合，以确定哪些历史记忆能为生成下一个记忆片段提供最有效的空间证据。 可靠性感知过滤可防止出现视觉漂移的新生成片段进入记忆，从而限制错误在后续重复使用中的传播。 这些原子操作共同构成了一个完整且统一的空间记忆管理机制。

sents.zh: 空间聚类通过将空间上邻近的记忆片段分组到同一簇中，从而组织记忆结构。

sents.en: Within-cluster sparsification removes redundant observations from each cluster to reduce storage costs.
sents.zh: 簇内稀疏化通过从每个簇中移除冗余的观察数据，来降低存储成本。

sents.en: Action-aware retrieval combines the recent context with the current action to determine which historical memories provide the most useful spatial evidence for generating the next chunk.
sents.zh: 动作感知检索将近期上下文与当前动作相结合，以确定哪些历史记忆能为生成下一个记忆片段提供最有效的空间证据。

sents.en: Reliability-aware filtering prevents newly generated chunks exhibiting visual drift from entering memory, limiting error propagation through subsequent reuse.
sents.zh: 可靠性感知过滤可防止出现视觉漂移的新生成片段进入记忆，从而限制错误在后续重复使用中的传播。

sents.en: Together, these atomic operations constitute a complete and unified mechanism for spatial-memory management.
sents.zh: 这些原子操作共同构成了一个完整且统一的空间记忆管理机制。

paragraphs.en: We introduce SMI, the first unified MLLM-driven framework for systematic spatial-memory management in long-horizon video world models. SMI defines four coordinated atomic operations for organizing, consolidating, filtering, and recalling spatial memory.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 SMI，这是首个基于 MLLM 的统一框架，用于长时程视频世界模型中的系统性空间记忆管理。 SMI 定义了四种协同的原子操作，用于组织、整合、筛选和回忆空间记忆。

sents.en: We introduce SMI, the first unified MLLM-driven framework for systematic spatial-memory management in long-horizon video world models.
sents.zh: 我们提出了 SMI，这是首个基于 MLLM 的统一框架，用于长时程视频世界模型中的系统性空间记忆管理。

sents.en: SMI defines four coordinated atomic operations for organizing, consolidating, filtering, and recalling spatial memory.
sents.zh: SMI 定义了四种协同的原子操作，用于组织、整合、筛选和回忆空间记忆。

paragraphs.en: We construct dedicated operation-oriented supervision datasets covering all four atomic operations and formulate these operations as learnable multimodal decision tasks, enabling the MLLM to develop unified reasoning capabilities for spatial-memory management.
paragraphs.zh: 我们构建了专门面向操作的监督数据集，涵盖全部四种原子操作，并将这些操作构造成可学习的多模态决策任务，从而使得 MLLM 能够发展出统一的推理能力以处理空间-记忆管理。

paragraphs.en: Extensive experiments across multiple baselines, benchmarks, and world-model backbones demonstrate the effectiveness and general applicability of SMI, with consistent improvements in memory sparsity, long-horizon generation stability, and visual consistency.
paragraphs.zh: 在多种基线、基准和世界模型主干架构上进行的广泛实验表明，SMI 具有有效性和广泛的适用性，并在记忆稀疏性、长期生成稳定性以及视觉一致性方面实现了持续改进。

paragraphs.en: Classical world models learn predictive environment representations for planning and control ( Ha & Schmidhuber, 2018 ; Hafner et al., 2023 ) . Enabled by scalable Diffusion Transformer architectures ( Peebles & Xie, 2023 ) , video generation has advanced substantially ( HaCohen et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2025c ; Wan et al., 2025 ) , accelerating the development of video world models for interactive simulation of evolving environments. Early video world models focused on controllable visual simulation in games and virtual environments ( Bruce et al., 2024 ; Che et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025b ) . Subsequent work has moved toward persistent world simulation, combining streaming generation ( Chen et al., 2024a ; Huang et al., 2025b ; Yuan et al., 2026 ) with interactive control ( Yu et al., 2025b ; Sun et al., 2025 ) to support long-horizon interaction in evolving environments ( Li et al., 2025a ; Hong et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026a ; Team et al., 2026b ) . Recent work has further extended video world modeling to multi-agent interaction ( Savva et al., 2026 ; Hu et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026a ) and embodied simulation for robotics and autonomous systems ( Pai et al., 2025 ; Agarwal et al., 2026 ; Ye et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026 ) . Despite these advances, persistent world simulation remains challenging, as long-horizon generation requires sparsifying an ever-growing observation history to reduce storage costs while preserving scene consistency and limiting error accumulation. This motivates spatial-memory management that jointly addresses memory sparsity, spatial consistency, and generation stability.
paragraphs.zh: 经典世界模型通过学习环境的预测性表示来实现规划与控制（Ha & Schmidhuber, 2018；Hafner et al., 2023）。 得益于可扩展的扩散Transformer架构（Peebles & Xie, 2023），视频生成技术已取得显著进展（HaCohen et al., 2024；Yang et al., 2025c；Wan et al., 2025），从而加速了用于动态环境交互式模拟的视频世界模型的发展。 早期的视频世界模型主要关注游戏和虚拟环境中的可控视觉模拟（Bruce et al., 2024；Che et al., 2025；Zhang et al., 2025b）。 后续研究转向了持续世界模拟，将流式生成（Chen et al., 2024a；Huang et al., 2025b；Yuan et al., 2026）与交互式控制（Yu et al., 2025b；Sun et al., 2025）相结合，以支持动态环境中的长期交互（Li et al., 2025a；Hong et al., 2025；Wang et al., 2026a；Team et al., 2026b）。 近期的研究进一步将视频世界建模扩展到多智能体交互（Savva et al., 2026；Hu et al., 2026；Liu et al., 2026a）以及面向机器人和自主系统的具身模拟（Pai et al., 2025；Agarwal et al., 2026；Ye et al., 2026；Li et al., 2026）。 尽管取得了这些进展，持续世界模拟仍然充满挑战，因为长期生成需要在不断增长的观测历史中进行稀疏化，以降低存储成本，同时保持场景一致性并限制误差累积。 这促使了空间-记忆管理方法的发展，该方法可同时解决记忆稀疏性、空间一致性和生成稳定性问题。

paragraphs.en: Long-horizon autoregressive generation accumulates observations across regions and viewpoints, increasing memory overhead and requiring generated content to remain spatially consistent when previously observed regions are revisited. Existing methods for long-horizon context management can be broadly categorized into memory compression, sparse computation, and selective retrieval. Compression-based methods ( Zhang et al., 2025a ; Jin et al., 2025 ; Savov et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2026 ; Hong et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ; Wei et al., 2026 ; Zhu et al., 2025a ) encode accumulated history into compact memory representations, reducing the amount of context retained over long horizons. However, compact representations may discard fine-grained visual and geometric information. Sparse-computation methods ( Xi et al., 2025 ; Cai et al., 2023 ; Choromanski et al., 2020 ; Xia et al., 2025 ; Cai et al., 2025 ; Glorian et al., 2026 ) exploit attention sparsity to reduce computational cost, focusing on efficient context processing rather than selective memory retention. Retrieval-based methods select relevant historical observations according to geometric relations or semantic similarity. Geometry-based retrieval ( Yu et al., 2025a ; Xiao et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2025c ; Ren et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025c ; Huang et al., 2025a ; Joo et al., 2026 ) relies on camera or geometry relevance and is sensitive to occlusion, dynamic content, semantic changes, and geometry errors. Semantic retrieval ( Ji et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2025d ) captures semantic relevance but can struggle to distinguish similar content across different locations or viewpoints. Some methods ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) further combine memory compression with implicit retrieval through an auxiliary encoder and the generative model, but remain limited by their spatial perception and semantic understanding. Overall, existing approaches address memory efficiency and retrieval through different mechanisms, but lack a unified framework for spatial-memory management.
paragraphs.zh: 长时程自回归生成会累积来自不同区域和视角的观察信息，从而增加内存开销，并要求在重新访问先前观察过的区域时，生成的内容保持空间一致性。 现有的长时程上下文管理方法大致可分为内存压缩、稀疏计算和选择性检索三类。 基于压缩的方法（Zhang et al., 2025a；Jin et al., 2025；Savov et al., 2025；Wu et al., 2026；Hong et al., 2025；Zhang et al., 2026b；Wei et al., 2026；Zhu et al., 2025a）将累积的历史信息编码为紧凑的内存表示，从而减少在长时程中保留的上下文量。 然而，紧凑的表示可能会丢弃精细的视觉和几何信息。 稀疏计算方法（Xi et al., 2025；Cai et al., 2023；Choromanski et al., 2020；Xia et al., 2025；Cai et al., 2025；Glorian et al., 2026）利用注意力的稀疏性来降低计算成本，专注于高效的上下文处理，而非选择性地保留内存。 基于检索的方法会根据几何关系或语义相似性选择相关的历史观察信息。 基于几何的检索方法（Yu et al., 2025a；Xiao et al., 2025；Wu et al., 2025c；Ren et al., 2025；Li et al., 2025c；Huang et al., 2025a；Joo et al., 2026）依赖相机或几何相关性，但对遮挡、动态内容、语义变化和几何错误较为敏感。 基于语义的检索方法（Ji et al., 2025；Wu et al., 2025d）能够捕捉语义相关性，但可能难以区分不同位置或视角下的相似内容。 一些方法（Zhang et al., 2026b）进一步通过辅助编码器和生成模型将内存压缩与隐式检索相结合，但仍受限于其空间感知和语义理解能力。 总体而言，现有方法通过不同的机制解决内存效率和检索问题，但缺乏统一的空间-内存管理框架。

paragraphs.en: Spatial-memory management inherently requires spatial perception, semantic understanding, and long-horizon reasoning. Recent advances in multimodal intelligence provide a natural foundation for these requirements. MLLMs have acquired increasingly strong capabilities in long-video reasoning ( Ren et al., 2024 ; Song et al., 2024 ; He et al., 2024 ) . Meanwhile, VLMs have progressed from basic spatial perception toward reasoning over 3D and multi-view environments, including cognitive-map construction and continuous scene understanding ( Chen et al., 2024b ; Ma et al., 2024 ; Ma et al., 2025b ; Yang et al., 2025a ; Wang et al., 2025 ; Zhu et al., 2025b ; Yang et al., 2025b ) . Furthermore, recent models explore depth and multi-view inputs, geometry-aware representations, and spatially grounded learning strategies to improve spatial perception and reasoning ( Daxberger et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2025b ; Ma et al., 2025a ; Li et al., 2025b ; Shen et al., 2025 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026c ) . In parallel, unified multimodal models are beginning to dissolve the traditional boundary between understanding and generation ( Lu et al., 2024 ; Jin et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2025a ; Xie et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2025e ; Deng et al., 2025 ) . These advances point toward a forward-looking paradigm in which understanding is not merely an auxiliary capability applied after generation, but an integral component that actively organizes and governs the generative process.
paragraphs.zh: 空间记忆管理本质上需要空间感知、语义理解和长期推理。 多模态智能领域的最新进展为这些需求提供了天然的基础。 MLLM 在长视频推理方面获得了日益强大的能力（Ren et al., 2024；Song et al., 2024；He et al., 2024）。 与此同时，VLM 已从基本的空间感知发展为对三维和多视角环境的推理，包括认知地图构建和连续场景理解（Chen et al., 2024b；Ma et al., 2024；Ma et al., 2025b；Yang et al., 2025a；Wang et al., 2025；Zhu et al., 2025b；Yang et al., 2025b）。 此外，近期模型探索了深度和多视角输入、几何感知表示以及基于空间的学习策略，以提升空间感知和推理能力（Daxberger et al., 2025；Wu et al., 2025b；Ma et al., 2025a；Li et al., 2025b；Shen et al., 2025；Zhao et al., 2026；Liu et al., 2026c）。 与此同时，统一的多模态模型开始打破理解与生成之间的传统界限（Lu et al., 2024；Jin et al., 2024；Wu et al., 2025a；Xie et al., 2025；Wu et al., 2025e；Deng et al., 2025）。 这些进展指向一种面向未来的范式：理解不再仅仅是生成之后应用的辅助能力，而是主动组织并调控生成过程的核心组成部分。

paragraphs.en: We propose Spatial Memory Intelligence (SMI), a unified framework that employs an MLLM to manage long-term spatial memory for video world models, as illustrated in Figure 2 . SMI comprises four coordinated atomic operations: spatial clustering, within-cluster sparsification, action-aware retrieval, and reliability-aware filtering. We begin by formalizing action-conditioned long-video generation in Section 4.1 and explaining the motivation for using an MLLM as the spatial-memory manager in Section 4.2 . We then introduce the four spatial-memory operations in Section 4.3 , followed by the operation-oriented data construction and training procedure in Section 4.4 .

paragraphs.en: Despite leveraging geometric or semantic information, existing memory-management strategies still exhibit retrieval limitations across diverse scenes, as illustrated in Figure 3 . Geometry-based retrieval can fail to identify useful memories under spatial occlusion, whereas semantic retrieval may overlook spatial and viewpoint changes. The fundamental limitation is that these approaches lack the ability to understand the relationships between spatial observations and to reason based on these relationships. Over long-horizon interaction, managing an increasingly complex observation history requires reasoning over historical states, tracking semantic and spatial changes during interaction, and relating observations across viewpoints and time. Meeting these demands remains challenging for both fixed heuristics and the generator’s implicit memory mechanisms.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管利用了几何或语义信息，现有的记忆管理策略在不同场景中仍存在检索局限性，如图 3 所示。 基于几何的检索方法在空间遮挡情况下可能无法识别有用的记忆，而语义检索则可能忽略空间和视角的变化。 根本性的局限在于，这些方法缺乏理解空间观察结果之间关系并据此进行推理的能力。 在长期交互过程中，管理日益复杂的观察历史需要对历史状态进行推理，追踪交互过程中的语义和空间变化，并将不同视角和时间点的观察结果关联起来。 无论是固定的启发式方法，还是生成器的隐式记忆机制，要满足这些需求仍然充满挑战。

paragraphs.en: These limitations call for a dedicated memory manager that can reason over the evolving history and determine how memory should be organized, retained, and retrieved for the current context. Scalable, data-driven MLLMs provide a natural basis for such a manager, as they can learn memory-management strategies from diverse multimodal data. Moreover, their growing capabilities in contextual understanding and semantic reasoning ( Alayrac et al., 2022 ; McKinzie et al., 2024 ; Bai et al., 2025a ) , together with rapid advances in spatial perception and reasoning ( Chen et al., 2024b ; Yang et al., 2025a ; Ma et al., 2025b ) , make MLLMs well suited to spatial-memory management in video world models. More broadly, progress toward unified understanding-and-generation architectures ( Wu et al., 2025a ; Xie et al., 2025 ; Deng et al., 2025 ) reflects a growing trend toward closer integration of multimodal understanding and generation. In this work, we establish an initial framework for managing spatial memory with an MLLM and define four atomic operations.

The number of retained items is not fixed in advance; instead, it is determined dynamically by the MLLM according to whether each item contains new spatial structure, object states, or occlusion relations. paragraphs.en: We assess overall performance using four complementary evaluation protocols. (1) VBench ( Huang et al., 2024 ) . We report background consistency, motion smoothness, and aesthetic quality to evaluate generation stability and consistency. (2) GPT-5.6-sol evaluation. Three independent GPT-5.6-sol evaluator agents blindly assess the generated videos. We report Camera-Constrained Scene Consistency and Overall Visual Quality, with the detailed evaluation protocol and full results provided in Appendix C . (3) Reconstruction consistency. Following WorldPlay, each model traverses a round-trip camera trajectory, and we compute PSNR and LPIPS between corresponding frames from the outbound and return paths. (4) User study. We conduct a user study to compare the generation stability and spatial consistency of SMI and the baselines. The evaluation protocol and results are provided in Appendix D . For VBench and GPT-5.6-sol evaluation, we use 100 randomly sampled one-minute rollouts. For reconstruction consistency, we use a separate set of 100 one-minute rollouts containing revisit trajectories. For fair evaluation, all test scenes are held out from the training set. We will release all datasets and model weights for reproducibility.

paragraphs.en: Besides the HY1.5 and Wan2.2 baselines that use a field-of-view (FoV)-based retrieval strategy, we compare SMI with five memory-management methods: FramePack and Deep Forcing for compression, Mixture of Contexts (MoC) for sparse-routing-based retrieval, VMem for geometry-based retrieval, and MemFlow for semantic retrieval. These methods cover four complementary strategies for long-term memory management: compression, sparsification, geometric retrieval, and semantic retrieval. For a fair comparison, all methods use the same initial observations, action sequences, random seeds, context budget, and generation configuration. More details are provided in Appendix E .

paragraphs.en: Tables 2 and 2 present quantitative comparisons between SMI and the baselines on HY1.5 and Wan2.2, respectively. paragraphs.en: In this work, we presented Spatial Memory Intelligence(SMI), the first unified framework that uses an understanding model to manage spatial memory in long-horizon video world models. SMI organizes memory through four coordinated atomic operations: spatial clustering, within-cluster sparsification, action-aware retrieval, and reliability-aware filtering. By sparsifying redundant memory observations while preserving useful spatial evidence, SMI substantially reduces memory overhead and improves long-horizon generation stability and spatial consistency. Extensive experiments across multiple baselines, benchmarks, and world-model backbones validate the effectiveness of SMI. Looking ahead, we hope this work takes a step toward a more general framework for spatial-memory management in future unified models.
paragraphs.zh: 在这项工作中，我们提出了空间记忆智能体（Spatial Memory Intelligence, SMI），这是首个利用理解模型来管理长时程视频世界模型中空间记忆的统一框架。 SMI 通过四种协同的原子操作来组织记忆：空间聚类、簇内稀疏化、动作感知检索和可靠性感知过滤。 通过稀疏化冗余的记忆观察结果，同时保留有用的空间证据，SMI 显著降低了记忆开销，并提升了长时程生成的稳定性与空间一致性。 在多种基线模型、基准测试和世界模型主干架构上进行的广泛实验验证了 SMI 的有效性。 展望未来，我们希望这项工作能为未来统一模型中的空间记忆管理迈向一个更通用的框架。

paragraphs.en: SMI has several limitations. First, the current framework is not trained end to end with the world model and therefore does not directly improve the intrinsic generation capability of the underlying backbone. Its performance remains bounded by the visual quality, controllability, and stability of the base generator. Second, because the understanding model and the generation model operate with different representations, the MLLM-based memory controller introduces additional computation, particularly during the early stages of a rollout before memory sparsification yields substantial savings. Third, the current task setting does not explicitly address long-horizon streaming understanding and may therefore remain insufficient for memory tasks involving complex long-term dependencies or logical reasoning.

paragraphs.en: We implement the four spatial-memory operations on HY1.5 and Wan2.2 as follows.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 HY1.5 和 Wan2.2 上按如下方式实现四种空间记忆操作。

paragraphs.en: We extract the middle frame from the newly generated chunk and from each candidate cluster prototype. The MLLM determines whether they depict the same spatial region. If a match exists, the new chunk is assigned to the corresponding cluster; otherwise, a new cluster is created.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从新生成的片段以及每个候选簇原型中提取中间帧。 MLLM 判断这些帧是否描绘了相同的空间区域。 如果存在匹配，则将新片段分配给对应的簇；否则，创建一个新的簇。

sents.en: We extract the middle frame from the newly generated chunk and from each candidate cluster prototype.
sents.zh: 我们从新生成的片段以及每个候选簇原型中提取中间帧。

sents.en: The MLLM determines whether they depict the same spatial region.
sents.zh: MLLM 判断这些帧是否描绘了相同的空间区域。

sents.en: If a match exists, the new chunk is assigned to the corresponding cluster; otherwise, a new cluster is created.
sents.zh: 如果存在匹配，则将新片段分配给对应的簇；否则，创建一个新的簇。

paragraphs.en: When the number of chunks in a cluster reaches a predefined threshold, we sample two frames from each chunk. The MLLM compares their spatial content to identify redundancy. An intermediate chunk is removed if it provides no additional spatial structure, object states, or occlusion information relative to its neighboring memories.
paragraphs.zh: 当集群中的分块数量达到预设阈值时，我们会从每个分块中采样两帧。 MLLM 会对比这些分块的空间内容以识别冗余信息。 如果某个中间分块相对于其相邻的记忆单元没有提供额外的空间结构、物体状态或遮挡信息，则会被移除。

sents.en: When the number of chunks in a cluster reaches a predefined threshold, we sample two frames from each chunk.
sents.zh: 当集群中的分块数量达到预设阈值时，我们会从每个分块中采样两帧。

sents.en: The MLLM compares their spatial content to identify redundancy.
sents.zh: MLLM 会对比这些分块的空间内容以识别冗余信息。

sents.en: An intermediate chunk is removed if it provides no additional spatial structure, object states, or occlusion information relative to its neighboring memories.
sents.zh: 如果某个中间分块相对于其相邻的记忆单元没有提供额外的空间结构、物体状态或遮挡信息，则会被移除。

paragraphs.en: We first shortlist the seven historical chunks whose camera positions are closest to the current camera position. The MLLM then considers the spatial location depicted in recent observations and the current action to select historical chunks that provide relevant spatial information for the current generation. Both backbones retain the two most recent chunks as context. No additional chunk is retrieved if none of the candidates is suitable.
paragraphs.zh: 我们首先筛选出七个历史片段，这些片段的摄像头位置与当前摄像头位置最为接近。 随后，MLLM 会结合近期观察中呈现的空间位置以及当前动作，选择能为当前生成提供相关空间信息的历史片段。 两个主干模型都将最近的两个片段保留为上下文。 如果候选片段中没有合适的，则不会检索任何额外的片段。

sents.en: We first shortlist the seven historical chunks whose camera positions are closest to the current camera position.
sents.zh: 我们首先筛选出七个历史片段，这些片段的摄像头位置与当前摄像头位置最为接近。

sents.en: The MLLM then considers the spatial location depicted in recent observations and the current action to select historical chunks that provide relevant spatial information for the current generation.
sents.zh: 随后，MLLM 会结合近期观察中呈现的空间位置以及当前动作，选择能为当前生成提供相关空间信息的历史片段。

sents.en: Both backbones retain the two most recent chunks as context.
sents.zh: 两个主干模型都将最近的两个片段保留为上下文。

sents.en: No additional chunk is retrieved if none of the candidates is suitable.
sents.zh: 如果候选片段中没有合适的，则不会检索任何额外的片段。

paragraphs.en: The MLLM scores each newly generated chunk on a scale of 1–10 for visual reliability, with higher scores indicating greater reliability. Chunks scoring below 6 are discarded rather than added to the memory bank, reducing the accumulation of generation errors through subsequent memory reuse.
paragraphs.zh: MLLM 对每个新生成的片段在视觉可靠性方面进行 1–10 分的评分，分数越高表示可靠性越强。 得分低于 6 的片段会被丢弃，而不是添加到记忆库中，从而减少后续通过重复使用记忆所累积的生成错误。

sents.en: The MLLM scores each newly generated chunk on a scale of 1–10 for visual reliability, with higher scores indicating greater reliability.
sents.zh: MLLM 对每个新生成的片段在视觉可靠性方面进行 1–10 分的评分，分数越高表示可靠性越强。

paragraphs.en: For each generated video, we sample one representative frame from every generated chunk and preserve their temporal order to form a long-horizon evaluation sequence. The corresponding action sequence is provided when judging camera-motion adherence. This chunk-level sampling retains the evolution of the generated scene while keeping the evaluation input tractable.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个生成的视频，我们从每个生成的片段中采样一个代表性帧，并保留其时间顺序，以形成一个长期评估序列。 在判断是否遵循相机运动时，会提供相应的动作序列。 这种片段级的采样方法既保留了生成场景的演化过程，又使评估输入易于处理。

sents.en: For each generated video, we sample one representative frame from every generated chunk and preserve their temporal order to form a long-horizon evaluation sequence.
sents.zh: 对于每个生成的视频，我们从每个生成的片段中采样一个代表性帧，并保留其时间顺序，以形成一个长期评估序列。

paragraphs.en: We use three independent GPT-5.6-sol evaluator agents. Method identities are hidden, and the candidate videos are presented in randomized order. All evaluators receive the same instruction and independently score the complete sequence. Their predictions are aggregated only after the three evaluations are completed, reducing the influence of ordering and individual evaluator variation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用三个独立的 GPT-5.6-sol 评估智能体。 方法身份被隐藏，候选视频以随机顺序呈现。 所有评估者都收到相同的指令，并独立地对完整序列进行评分。 只有在三次评估全部完成后，才会汇总他们的预测结果，从而减少顺序和个体评估者差异带来的影响。

sents.zh: 我们使用三个独立的 GPT-5.6-sol 评估智能体。

sents.zh: 只有在三次评估全部完成后，才会汇总他们的预测结果，从而减少顺序和个体评估者差异带来的影响。

paragraphs.en: The protocol assesses adjacent transition continuity, long-range identity preservation, cumulative geometric consistency, overall scene consistency, camera-motion adherence, structural integrity, artifact cleanliness, detail clarity, and overall visual quality. These dimensions jointly capture the consistency, stability, continuity, and visual reliability of long-horizon generation.
paragraphs.zh: 该协议评估了相邻转换的连续性、长程身份保持、累积几何一致性、整体场景一致性、对相机运动的遵循性、结构完整性、伪影纯净度、细节清晰度以及整体视觉质量。 这些维度共同捕捉了长期生成过程的一致性、稳定性、连续性和视觉可靠性。

sents.zh: 这些维度共同捕捉了长期生成过程的一致性、稳定性、连续性和视觉可靠性。

paragraphs.en: The main paper reports Camera-Constrained Scene Consistency (the Camera-Gated Scene column below) and Overall Visual Quality. Tables 5 and 6 report all nine score dimensions for HY1.5 and Wan2.2. Bold marks the highest score in each column.

paragraphs.en: We compare Base, VMem, FramePack, and SMI on 15 scenes, with videos lasting 45–60 seconds under matched initial observations and action sequences. Twenty participants evaluate scene consistency and generation stability. As shown in Table 7 , SMI leads all compared methods in both dimensions, receiving best-choice preference shares of 52.50% for scene consistency and 57.83% for generation stability.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 15 个场景上对比了 Base、VMem、FramePack 和 SMI，这些场景的视频时长为 45–60 秒，且初始观察结果和行动序列均保持一致。 二十名参与者对场景一致性和生成稳定性进行了评估。 如表 7 所示，SMI 在这两个维度上均优于所有对比方法，在场景一致性方面获得了 52.50% 的最佳选择偏好份额，在生成稳定性方面则获得了 57.83% 的份额。

sents.en: We compare Base, VMem, FramePack, and SMI on 15 scenes, with videos lasting 45–60 seconds under matched initial observations and action sequences.
sents.zh: 我们在 15 个场景上对比了 Base、VMem、FramePack 和 SMI，这些场景的视频时长为 45–60 秒，且初始观察结果和行动序列均保持一致。

paragraphs.en: We compare Base, FramePack, Deep Forcing, Mixture of Contexts (MoC), VMem, MemFlow, and SMI on HY1.5 and Wan2.2, keeping the backbone weights unchanged. Within each backbone, all methods share the same initial observations, action sequences, random seeds, context budget, and generation settings. We retain the two most recent chunks as local context and retrieve at most two additional historical chunks for HY1.5 and three for Wan2.2.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 HY1.5 和 Wan2.2 上对 Base、FramePack、Deep Forcing、Mixture of Contexts (MoC)、VMem、MemFlow 和 SMI 进行了比较，同时保持骨干网络权重不变。 在每个骨干网络内部，所有方法都共享相同的初始观测、动作序列、随机种子、上下文预算和生成设置。 我们将最近两个片段保留为本地上下文，并为 HY1.5 最多检索两个额外的历史片段，为 Wan2.2 最多检索三个。

sents.en: We compare Base, FramePack, Deep Forcing, Mixture of Contexts (MoC), VMem, MemFlow, and SMI on HY1.5 and Wan2.2, keeping the backbone weights unchanged.
sents.zh: 我们在 HY1.5 和 Wan2.2 上对 Base、FramePack、Deep Forcing、Mixture of Contexts (MoC)、VMem、MemFlow 和 SMI 进行了比较，同时保持骨干网络权重不变。

sents.en: Within each backbone, all methods share the same initial observations, action sequences, random seeds, context budget, and generation settings.
sents.zh: 在每个骨干网络内部，所有方法都共享相同的初始观测、动作序列、随机种子、上下文预算和生成设置。

sents.en: We retain the two most recent chunks as local context and retrieve at most two additional historical chunks for HY1.5 and three for Wan2.2.
sents.zh: 我们将最近两个片段保留为本地上下文，并为 HY1.5 最多检索两个额外的历史片段，为 Wan2.2 最多检索三个。

paragraphs.en: Base. The original backbone retains the local context and retrieves earlier chunks according to field-of-view overlap, up to the backbone-specific cap. It does not use an auxiliary memory manager.
paragraphs.zh: 基础。 原始主干保留局部上下文，并根据视场重叠情况检索先前的片段，最多不超过主干特定的上限。 它不使用辅助内存管理器。

sents.en: Base.
sents.zh: 基础。

sents.en: The original backbone retains the local context and retrieves earlier chunks according to field-of-view overlap, up to the backbone-specific cap.
sents.zh: 原始主干保留局部上下文，并根据视场重叠情况检索先前的片段，最多不超过主干特定的上限。

sents.en: It does not use an auxiliary memory manager.
sents.zh: 它不使用辅助内存管理器。

paragraphs.en: FramePack. We adapt FramePack’s temporal hierarchy to the chunk interface. One initial anchor is retained, and older observations are selected by temporal distance using the 4 × 4\times , 2 × 2\times , and 1 × 1\times tiers. The selected observations follow the native context path; no FramePack-specific encoder or weight is introduced.
paragraphs.zh: FramePack。 我们将 FramePack 的时间层级适配到分块接口中。 保留一个初始锚点，并通过时间距离，利用 4 × 4\times、2 × 2\times 和 1 × 1\times 层级选择更早的观察数据。 所选的观察数据遵循原生上下文路径；未引入任何 FramePack 特定的编码器或权重。

sents.en: FramePack.
sents.zh: FramePack。

sents.en: We adapt FramePack’s temporal hierarchy to the chunk interface.
sents.zh: 我们将 FramePack 的时间层级适配到分块接口中。

sents.en: One initial anchor is retained, and older observations are selected by temporal distance using the 4 × 4\times , 2 × 2\times , and 1 × 1\times tiers.

sents.zh: 所选的观察数据遵循原生上下文路径；未引入任何 FramePack 特定的编码器或权重。

paragraphs.en: Mixture of Contexts (MoC). We adapt the MoC routing idea as a global chunk router at inference. Each chunk contributes a compact block-0 attention descriptor. At each step, the router ranks remote chunks by query-key similarity and combines the highest-scoring chunks with the two local chunks, subject to the backbone-specific cap.
paragraphs.zh: 上下文混合（MoC）。 我们在推理阶段将 MoC 路由思想改编为全局分块路由器。 每个分块都会贡献一个紧凑的 block-0 注意力描述符。 在每一步中，路由器会根据查询-键相似度对远程分块进行排序，并将得分最高的分块与两个本地分块合并，同时受限于模型主干特定的上限。

sents.en: Mixture of Contexts (MoC).
sents.zh: 上下文混合（MoC）。

sents.en: We adapt the MoC routing idea as a global chunk router at inference.
sents.zh: 我们在推理阶段将 MoC 路由思想改编为全局分块路由器。

sents.en: Each chunk contributes a compact block-0 attention descriptor.
sents.zh: 每个分块都会贡献一个紧凑的 block-0 注意力描述符。

sents.en: At each step, the router ranks remote chunks by query-key similarity and combines the highest-scoring chunks with the two local chunks, subject to the backbone-specific cap.
sents.zh: 在每一步中，路由器会根据查询-键相似度对远程分块进行排序，并将得分最高的分块与两个本地分块合并，同时受限于模型主干特定的上限。

paragraphs.en: Deep Forcing. Deep Forcing uses a token-level cache with a 10-frame deep-sink prefix and a 4-frame recent query window. When the cache is full, non-sink historical tokens are retained according to attention scores; temporal RoPE positions are compensated after reorganization. We use the strict token-cache implementation and do not use the separate random-selection or compression-free variants.
paragraphs.zh: 深度强制。 深度强制使用一种基于词元的缓存机制，包含一个 10 帧的深度沉底前缀和一个 4 帧的近期查询窗口。 当缓存满时，非沉底的历史词元会根据注意力分数被保留；重组织后会补偿时间 RoPE 位置。 我们采用严格的词元缓存实现，并未使用独立的随机选择或无压缩变体。

sents.en: Deep Forcing.
sents.zh: 深度强制。

sents.en: Deep Forcing uses a token-level cache with a 10-frame deep-sink prefix and a 4-frame recent query window.
sents.zh: 深度强制使用一种基于词元的缓存机制，包含一个 10 帧的深度沉底前缀和一个 4 帧的近期查询窗口。

sents.en: When the cache is full, non-sink historical tokens are retained according to attention scores; temporal RoPE positions are compensated after reorganization.
sents.zh: 当缓存满时，非沉底的历史词元会根据注意力分数被保留；重组织后会补偿时间 RoPE 位置。

sents.en: We use the strict token-cache implementation and do not use the separate random-selection or compression-free variants.
sents.zh: 我们采用严格的词元缓存实现，并未使用独立的随机选择或无压缩变体。

paragraphs.en: VMem. Our VMem implementation builds a surfel map from geometry estimated by LoGeR ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) and scores historical chunks by their contribution to the target-view rendering. It combines the two local chunks with at most two additional chunks on HY1.5 or three on Wan2.2, and then re-encodes the selected chunks through the native context path.
paragraphs.zh: VMem。 我们的 VMem 实现基于 LoGeR（Zhang 等人，2026a）估计出的几何信息构建 surfel 地图，并根据历史分块对目标视角渲染的贡献度进行评分。 它在 HY1.5 上最多结合两个额外分块，在 Wan2.2 上最多结合三个额外分块，然后通过原生上下文路径对选定的分块进行重新编码。

sents.en: VMem.
sents.zh: VMem。

sents.en: Our VMem implementation builds a surfel map from geometry estimated by LoGeR ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) and scores historical chunks by their contribution to the target-view rendering.
sents.zh: 我们的 VMem 实现基于 LoGeR（Zhang 等人，2026a）估计出的几何信息构建 surfel 地图，并根据历史分块对目标视角渲染的贡献度进行评分。

sents.en: It combines the two local chunks with at most two additional chunks on HY1.5 or three on Wan2.2, and then re-encodes the selected chunks through the native context path.
sents.zh: 它在 HY1.5 上最多结合两个额外分块，在 Wan2.2 上最多结合三个额外分块，然后通过原生上下文路径对选定的分块进行重新编码。

paragraphs.en: MemFlow. We adapt MemFlow’s semantic-retrieval component to the native chunk interface. Every second chunk contributes its first decoded RGB frame as a candidate, and the last decoded frame of the preceding chunk is used as the query. We rank candidates by CLIP ( Radford et al., 2021 ) image-image cosine similarity, exclude the two local chunks, and retrieve at most two remote chunks on HY1.5 or three on Wan2.2.
paragraphs.zh: MemFlow。 我们将 MemFlow 的语义检索组件适配到本地分块接口中。 每个第二个分块将其首个解码出的 RGB 帧作为候选项，而前一个分块的最后一个解码帧则用作查询。 我们通过 CLIP（Radford 等人，2021）的图像-图像余弦相似度对候选项进行排序，排除两个本地分块，并在 HY1.5 上最多检索两个远程分块，或在 Wan2.2 上最多检索三个远程分块。

sents.en: MemFlow.
sents.zh: MemFlow。

sents.en: We adapt MemFlow’s semantic-retrieval component to the native chunk interface.
sents.zh: 我们将 MemFlow 的语义检索组件适配到本地分块接口中。

sents.en: Every second chunk contributes its first decoded RGB frame as a candidate, and the last decoded frame of the preceding chunk is used as the query.
sents.zh: 每个第二个分块将其首个解码出的 RGB 帧作为候选项，而前一个分块的最后一个解码帧则用作查询。

sents.en: We rank candidates by CLIP ( Radford et al., 2021 ) image-image cosine similarity, exclude the two local chunks, and retrieve at most two remote chunks on HY1.5 or three on Wan2.2.
sents.zh: 我们通过 CLIP（Radford 等人，2021）的图像-图像余弦相似度对候选项进行排序，排除两个本地分块，并在 HY1.5 上最多检索两个远程分块，或在 Wan2.2 上最多检索三个远程分块。

paragraphs.en: We first collect approximately one thousand videos, each longer than one minute, from actual world-model inference and manually remove low-quality videos. We then manually annotate 354 samples in total across the four operations, providing reliable supervision examples for the subsequent annotation stage.
paragraphs.zh: 我们首先从实际世界模型推理中收集约一千个时长均超过一分钟的视频，并手动移除低质量视频。 接着，我们对四项操作中的总共 354 个样本进行手动标注，为后续标注阶段提供可靠的监督示例。

sents.en: We first collect approximately one thousand videos, each longer than one minute, from actual world-model inference and manually remove low-quality videos.
sents.zh: 我们首先从实际世界模型推理中收集约一千个时长均超过一分钟的视频，并手动移除低质量视频。

sents.en: We then manually annotate 354 samples in total across the four operations, providing reliable supervision examples for the subsequent annotation stage.

paragraphs.en: Using the manually annotated samples as few-shot demonstrations, GPT-5.6-sol and Gemini-3.1 Pro annotate the remaining data. Claude Fable 5 then examines the annotations produced by the two teacher MLLMs and flags anomalous outputs. Finally, we further review and clean the flagged samples to obtain the complete training dataset.
paragraphs.zh: 使用人工标注的样本作为少样本演示，GPT-5.6-sol 和 Gemini-3.1 Pro 对剩余数据进行标注。 随后，Claude Fable 5 会检查两个教师 MLLM 生成的标注结果，并标记出异常输出。 最后，我们进一步审查并清理被标记的样本，以获得完整的训练数据集。

sents.en: Using the manually annotated samples as few-shot demonstrations, GPT-5.6-sol and Gemini-3.1 Pro annotate the remaining data.
sents.zh: 使用人工标注的样本作为少样本演示，GPT-5.6-sol 和 Gemini-3.1 Pro 对剩余数据进行标注。

sents.en: Claude Fable 5 then examines the annotations produced by the two teacher MLLMs and flags anomalous outputs.
sents.zh: 随后，Claude Fable 5 会检查两个教师 MLLM 生成的标注结果，并标记出异常输出。

sents.en: Finally, we further review and clean the flagged samples to obtain the complete training dataset.
sents.zh: 最后，我们进一步审查并清理被标记的样本，以获得完整的训练数据集。

paragraphs.en: The resulting samples are organized according to the four atomic operations. Reliability-aware filtering predicts the visual reliability of a newly generated chunk. Spatial clustering determines whether a new chunk matches an existing spatial prototype. Within-cluster sparsification determines whether a candidate chunk is redundant given the remaining memories in the same cluster. Action-aware retrieval selects historical chunks that can support generation under the current context and planned action. Each sample pairs its operation-specific multimodal input ℐ n \mathcal{I}_{n} with a structured target output Y n Y_{n} .
paragraphs.zh: 生成的样本按照四种原子操作进行组织。 可靠性感知过滤会预测新生成片段在视觉上的可靠性。 空间聚类用于判断新片段是否与现有的空间原型匹配。 簇内稀疏化会基于同一簇中剩余的内存，判断候选片段是否冗余。 动作感知检索会选择在当前上下文和计划动作下能够支持生成的历史片段。 每个样本都将与其操作特定的多模态输入 ℐ n \mathcal{I}_{n} 配对一个结构化的目标输出 Y n Y_{n}。

sents.en: The resulting samples are organized according to the four atomic operations.
sents.zh: 生成的样本按照四种原子操作进行组织。

sents.zh: 可靠性感知过滤会预测新生成片段在视觉上的可靠性。

sents.en: Spatial clustering determines whether a new chunk matches an existing spatial prototype.
sents.zh: 空间聚类用于判断新片段是否与现有的空间原型匹配。

sents.en: Within-cluster sparsification determines whether a candidate chunk is redundant given the remaining memories in the same cluster.
sents.zh: 簇内稀疏化会基于同一簇中剩余的内存，判断候选片段是否冗余。

sents.en: Action-aware retrieval selects historical chunks that can support generation under the current context and planned action.

paragraphs.en: The visual-quality task assigns a reliability score from 1 to 10 to a newly generated chunk. Following the filtering rule used by SMI, chunks with scores no greater than 6 are labeled as filtered, while chunks with scores greater than 6 are retained. Under this binary grouping, 24.55% of HY1.5 samples and 38.79% of Wan2.2 samples are filtered. The remaining 75.45% and 61.21%, respectively, are retained. These statistics characterize the supervision distribution rather than the runtime filtering rate.
paragraphs.zh: 视觉质量任务为新生成的片段分配一个从 1 到 10 的可靠性分数。 遵循 SMI 使用的过滤规则，分数不超过 6 的片段被标记为已过滤，而分数高于 6 的片段则被保留。 在这种二元分组中，24.55% 的 HY1.5 样本和 38.79% 的 Wan2.2 样本被过滤。 其余的样本分别保留了 75.45% 和 61.21%。 这些统计数据反映的是监督分布，而非运行时的过滤率。

paragraphs.en: Coverage supervision conditions memory selection on the planned camera motion. Table 10 reports the motion distribution over 24,623 HY1.5 and 6,852 Wan2.2 training occurrences.
